=== SUBCOMMAND: add-agent ===
add an agent to the running session (opened by the add-agent key)

Usage: add-agent

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: answer-query ===
answer an agent coordination query

Usage: answer-query --id <ID> --answer <ANSWER>

Options:
      --id <ID>          query ID to answer
      --answer <ANSWER>  answer text
  -h, --help             Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: click ===
dispatch a status-bar or pane-menu click action

Usage: click [ACTION]

Arguments:
  [ACTION]  action name from the hint bar [default: ""]

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: click-tab ===
open the agent menu for a clicked column title

Usage: click-tab [OPTIONS] <PANE>

Arguments:
  <PANE>  pane id (%N format)

Options:
      --select <SELECT>  pane id of the agent to switch to [default: ""]
  -h, --help             Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: close-agent ===
close the focused agent

Usage: close-agent

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: discard-exit ===
end the session and delete the saved state

Usage: discard-exit

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: equalize ===
equalize pane split or reset border to default

Usage: equalize [PANE]

Arguments:
  [PANE]  [default: ""]

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: first-run ===
open help once on first attach

Usage: first-run

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: focus ===
focus a column or the status window

Usage: focus <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  [possible values: planner, implementer, status, queries, sidebar, settings]

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: grid-scroll ===
scroll the multi-agent grid

Usage: grid-scroll <DELTA>

Arguments:
  <DELTA>  

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: gridbar ===
run the grid overflow scrollbar

Usage: gridbar

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: help ===
show the key help

Usage: help

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: list-ips ===
list host network IPs and active workspaces

Usage: list-ips [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json  output candidate IPs in JSON format
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: placeholder ===
empty-column placeholder

Usage: placeholder <ROLE>

Arguments:
  <ROLE>  

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: quit ===
detach or quit

Usage: quit

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: quota-feed ===
Claude Code statusline hook: record quota, then run your own statusline

Usage: quota-feed

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: quota-line ===
print the quota line shown under the window

Usage: quota-line

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: reflow ===
re-stack columns for the terminal size

Usage: reflow

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: refresh ===
redraw tab titles

Usage: refresh

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: reload ===
restart tandem's own windows on the installed code

Usage: reload

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: rename-agent ===
rename an agent to a custom alphanumeric name

Usage: rename-agent <TARGET> [NAME]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  pane id (%...) or session id (role-index) to rename
  [NAME]    new alphanumeric name (1..=32 chars, or empty to reset to default)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: rename-workspace ===
rename the current workspace to a custom alphanumeric name

Usage: rename-workspace [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]  new alphanumeric name (1..=32 chars, or empty to reset to default)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: reset-layout ===
reset pane sizes to the defaults

Usage: reset-layout

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: reset-ui ===
reset UI layout, sizes, grid and sidebar to defaults

Usage: reset-ui

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: restart ===
restart an exited agent

Usage: restart

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: save-exit ===
save the session state and end the session

Usage: save-exit

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: select ===
select an agent or toggle it in the grid

Usage: select [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  

Options:
      --toggle  
  -h, --help    Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: show ===
show an agent in the main window

Usage: show <PANE>

Arguments:
  <PANE>  pane id (%N format)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: sidebar ===
run the agent sidebar

Usage: sidebar

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: snapshot ===
output workspace snapshot in JSON format

Usage: snapshot [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json                       output snapshot in JSON format
      --watch                      keep running; print one JSON line each time the snapshot changes
      --interval-ms <INTERVAL_MS>  watch mode: milliseconds between checks [default: 1000]
      --pretty                     indent the JSON (one-shot mode only)
  -h, --help                       Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: status ===
run the status window

Usage: status

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: tab ===
switch agent tab in the focused column

Usage: tab <DIRECTION> [NUMBER]

Arguments:
  <DIRECTION>  [possible values: prev, next, select]
  [NUMBER]     

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: update ===
update tandem and the workspace; agents keep running (F10 menu)

Usage: update [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --yes   do not ask for confirmation
  -h, --help  Print help


=== SUBCOMMAND: whats-new ===
show what changed in the last update

Usage: whats-new

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
